sub_assemblies.name: Tower module (welded)
sub_assemblies.summary: 3000x3000 crs x 2807.2 high: 4 UC152x152x23 columns, 8 UB127x76x13 ties, 4 UB127x76x13 braces, 8 gussets, 8 pads

sub_assemblies.name: Deck (welded)
sub_assemblies.summary: 4000x4000 deck: 2 UB203x133x25 main beams, 6 UB152x89x16 joists, 10mm plate, 4 pads, 8 stiffeners, CHS guardrails

assumptions: Column grid kept at 3000 x 3000 (footprint unchanged); deck now 4000 x 4000, cantilevering 500 past the columns on all sides
Finished deck level 6000: two modules of 2807.2 + 385.6 deck build-up
25t treated as a static load spread over the deck (about 15.3 kN/m2); concentrated feet need spreaders or a re-check
EN 1993-1-1, S355 UC/UB to EN 10365; gamma_Q 1.5, gamma_G 1.35; worst column takes 50% of the imposed load
Indoor (no wind); horizontal design load 5% of factored vertical at deck level
Braces also UB 127x76x13 (UB/UC throughout), web lapped onto a 10mm gusset, 190 lap fillet welded
Columns turned 90 deg at each corner so every face has one tie-beam end on a column web and one on a flange
Deck: joists sit on top of main beams; bearing stiffeners (pair) over each column
Shop welded inside each module and deck; site bolted 4 x M20 8.8 per pad between modules and deck
Guardrails CHS 48.3x3.2, posts over joists / edge joist at <= 1304 crs, welded to deck plate
No access opening, gate or ladder included - position to be confirmed
Root radii, weld preps and lifting points not modelled; ground anchors by others
